description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' that interacts with JavaScript via JSInterop to handle routing actions in a Blazor web application. It includes a method to navigate outside the current route by invoking a JavaScript function asynchronously.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A class providing JavaScript interop methods for routing, specifically for navigating outside current routes.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to navigate outside the current route using the provided path.
